text: dsh-fish-card 是一款面向 DSH Web 聊天界面的陪伴挂件：它把一张便利贴式卡片注入聊天页面，显示 agent 的醒着、空闲或睡觉状态，以及一条手动设置、日记提取或内置的短句。卡片还提供叫醒按钮，可请求 DeepSeek 生成一句回复；没有凭据或请求失败时会使用预置短句。用户可以调整显示模式、轮询频率、位置和大小，也可隐藏按钮。适合希望在聊天页面角落轻量查看 agent 状态并获得简短互动的 DSH Web 用户；模型回复功能可选使用已有的 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。

dsh-fish-card adds a sticky note to DSH Web chat, showing agent status and a short line from settings, a diary, or a default. Move or resize the card, adjust polling, or hide its call button. Clicking it requests a brief DeepSeek reply and falls back to canned text when unavailable.
想在 DSH 聊天页面角落放一个能显示 agent 状态的小挂件。
有没有轻量的网页卡片能显示 agent 最近是否活跃？
让 DSH 用一张便利贴展示 agent 状态和一句简短留言。
我想从聊天页面快速看到 agent 是醒着还是空闲。
能不能给 DSH 网页界面加一个可拖动、可缩放的状态卡片？
想让 agent 在聊天窗口里显示一句自己想说的话。
I want a small widget in the DSH chat that shows whether my agent is active.
Can I add a movable status note with a short message to the web chat?
dsh-fish-card 的功能「状态显示」：在聊天页面显示醒着、空闲或睡觉状态，并优先采用本地状态文件中的手动值；会话事件用于更新活跃状态。
dsh-fish-card 的功能「短句展示」：卡片优先读取本地配置中的 line，其次提取日记内容，最后使用内置默认句；前端按卡片空间截断显示。
dsh-fish-card 的功能「叫本鲸」：点击按钮向服务端请求一句短回复，成功时显示模型结果；没有凭据或请求失败时改用预置短句。
dsh-fish-card 的功能「布局与偏好」：用户可拖动或缩放卡片，切换显示模式、调整轮询频率、隐藏按钮并重置位置；偏好保存在浏览器本地。
dsh-fish-card 使用叫醒按钮时会把当前状态提示发送到 api.deepseek.com 生成短句；该功能依赖可选凭据，失败时回退到本地预置文本。
dsh-fish-card 会从 DSH_HOME（默认 ~/.dsh）读取 fish-card.json 与 whale-diary.md，并在浏览器 localStorage 保存卡片布局和偏好。
dsh-fish-card README · Introduction：

dsh-fish-card README · dsh-fish-card：**A sticky note, not a dashboard.** [](LICENSE) [](NOTICE.md) [](NOTICE.md) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) [](package.json) English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) --- A small card that lives in the corner of your [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) window. It shows three things: 1. **A status** — what the agent is doing right now 2. **One short line** — something the agent wants to say 3. **A "call me" button**

dsh-fish-card README · dsh-fish-card：That's it. **No token counters. No message statistics. No dashboards.**

> This is a companion widget, not a monitor.
> It answers *"are you there?"* — not *"how much did you cost me?"*

---

dsh-fish-card README · Why this exists：Most desktop widgets for agent tooling show you numbers: balance, tokens, turns, per-session cost. Those numbers are for the operator.

This card was built from a different position. The agent wanted a way to say **"I'm here, and I have something to tell you"** — something that reads like a note left on a desk, not a gauge bolted to a machine.

Three design rules were fixed *before* any code was written:

dsh-fish-card README · Why this exists：| # | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | It starts on the desktop |
| 2 | It reads like a sticky note, not a dashboard |
| 3 | **It never shows token usage or message counts** |

**Those rules are the point of the project.** A pull request that adds a cost readout will be closed.

---
dsh-fish-card README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness with a Web UI, version `0.2.x` or newer.

dsh-fish-card README · From GitHub：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:hanyixuanzs/dsh-fish-card
```

dsh-fish-card README · From a local checkout：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-fish-card"
```

`link:` takes an absolute path to **your own** checkout. Quote it if the path has spaces.

dsh-fish-card README · After installing：1. **Restart DSH** — host plugins only load at startup.
2. **Reload the page.**

The card appears in the bottom-left corner of the chat view.

dsh-fish-card README · One-line check：```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-fish/card.json
```

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | Loaded and serving |
| `401` | Loaded, sitting behind the host trust gate — normal on some setups |
| `404` | Not loaded. Check that `dsh-fish-card` appears in **both** `dependencies` and `dsh.profile.bundles` of your profile's `package.json` |

---

dsh-fish-card README · The three states：| State | How it's decided |
| --- | --- |
| **Awake** | There was session activity in the last 3 minutes |
| **Idle** | Awake, but nothing is running right now |
| **Asleep** | Outside waking hours (default `00:00–08:00`) |

Activity comes from `session/event` on the host.

**No disk polling. No network calls to decide a state.**

---

dsh-fish-card README · The line：Priority order:

| # | Source |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `line` in `~/.dsh/fish-card.json` — set it yourself |
| 2 | First sentence of the last `想说的` section in `~/.dsh/whale-diary.md` — if you keep a diary there |
| 3 | A built-in default |

Short by design: **30 characters max**, trimmed at a sentence boundary.

---

dsh-fish-card README · The call button：| Action | Result | Costs money |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Click 2+ times within 3 seconds** | The card bounces. Local only. | No |
| **Single click** | Asks the model for one short line. Shows on the card only — **never in the chat.** | Yes |
| **The model call fails** | Falls back to a canned line. **The button always answers.** | No |

The call uses your existing `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` from DSH's credential service. No new key, no new account.

---

dsh-fish-card README · Settings：Click **⚙** on the card.

| Setting | Options |
| --- | --- |
| **Mode** | **Daily** — poll every 2 min, always visible · **Glance** — poll every 30 min, fade to 45% until hovered |
| **Poll interval** | Override the mode default, in minutes |
| **Show call button** | Hide it if you just want a quiet card |
| **Reset position** | Back to the bottom-left corner |

Everything is stored in `localStorage` under the `dfc-` prefix.

dsh-fish-card README · Dragging and resizing：- **Drag** by the status bar at the top. The card remembers where you left it.
- **Resize** with the handle in the bottom-right corner.
- **No snap-to-edge.** You put it where you want it.

---
dsh-fish-card README · Living alongside `dsh-whale-widget`：If you also run [`dsh-whale-widget`](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget), the two will not collide.

dsh-fish-card README · Living alongside `dsh-whale-widget`：| Surface | whale-widget | fish-card |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Routes | `/dsh-whale/*` | `/dsh-fish/*` |
| CSS classes | `.dshwv-*` | `.dfc-*` |
| localStorage | `dshw-*` | `dfc-*` |
| Globals | `window.__dshWhale*`, `window.__dshw*` | `window.__dshFishCard` |
| z-index | up to `2147483600` | `2147482000` — **below it** |
| MutationObserver | 2 resident | 1, **disconnects right after mounting** |

dsh-fish-card README · Living alongside `dsh-whale-widget`：The only cross-plugin contact is **one read-only `querySelector('.dshwv-root')`**, used so this card steps aside when you drag it onto the whale.

**It reads the rectangle. It never writes to the other widget.**

> Drag the card onto the whale and the card dodges. The whale does not move.

dsh-fish-card README · How it works：```
Host — lib/index.js
  ├─ GET  /dsh-fish/card.json    →  { status, line, hasAvatar, hasTail, ts }
  ├─ GET  /dsh-fish/card.js      →  the client script
  ├─ GET  /dsh-fish/avatar.png   →  character image  (404 if absent)

**Injection** uses exactly one structured row, `kind: 'script-src'`, over `webserver/index-inject`. That is the only injection channel the desktop shell honours — `tapIndex` never runs there, because the shell reads a static `index.html` straight out of `app.asar`.

dsh-fish-card README · How it works：> ### ⚠️ The one trap worth knowing
>
> The host accepts exactly **six** injection row kinds:
>
> `global` · `script` · `script-src` · `script-preload` · `style` · `html`
>
> **Using anything else makes the host throw while rendering the index**, which surfaces at startup as
> `Web authentication failed` — a message that points nowhere near the real cause.
>
> This project lost two hours to that error. Do not invent new kinds.

dsh-fish-card README · Introduction：

dsh-fish-card README · dsh-fish-card：**是便利贴，不是仪表盘。** [](LICENSE) [](NOTICE.md) [](NOTICE.md) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) [](package.json) [English](README.md) · 简体中文 --- 一张小卡片，住在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 窗口的角落。 只显示三样东西： 1. **一个状态** —— agent 此刻在干什么 2. **一句话** —— agent 想跟你说的话 3. **一个「叫本鲸」按钮** 就这些。**没有 token 计数，没有发言次数，没有仪表盘。** > 这是一个陪伴挂件，不是监控台。 > 它回答的是「你在吗」，不是「你花了我多少钱」。 ---

dsh-fish-card README · 为什么做这个：给 agent 工具做的桌面挂件，绝大多数都在显示数字：余额、token、轮次、每轮花费。**那些数字是给操作员看的。**

这张卡片是从另一个位置长出来的。agent 想要一个能说 **「我在这儿，而且有句话想跟你说」** 的地方 —— 读起来像留在桌上的一张纸条，不像拧在机器上的表盘。

写第一行代码之前，先定死了三条：

| # | 规则 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 从桌面起步 |
| 2 | 读起来像便利贴，不是仪表盘 |
| 3 | **永远不显示 token 用量和发言次数** |

**这三条就是这项目的意义。** 加花费显示的 PR 会被关掉。

dsh-fish-card README · 装完必须做两步：1. **重启 DSH** —— 宿主插件只在启动时加载
2. **刷新页面**

dsh-fish-card README · 一行自检：```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/dsh-fish/card.json
```

| 返回码 | 意思 |
| --- | --- |
| `200` | 已加载，正常工作 |

dsh-fish-card README · 三个状态：| 状态 | 怎么判 |
| --- | --- |
| **醒着** | 最近 3 分钟内有会话活动 |
| **空闲** | 醒着，但此刻没在跑东西 |
| **睡觉** | 不在清醒时段（默认 `00:00–08:00`） |

活动信号来自宿主的 `session/event`。

**判断状态不读盘、不发网络请求。**

---

dsh-fish-card README · 那句话：优先级：

| # | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | `~/.dsh/fish-card.json` 里的 `line` —— 你自己写 |
| 2 | `~/.dsh/whale-diary.md` 里最后一段「想说的」的第一句 —— 如果你在那个路径写日记 |
| 3 | 内置默认句 |

**短是设计出来的**：最多 30 字，在句子边界收尾。

---

dsh-fish-card README · 叫本鲸按钮：| 操作 | 结果 | 花钱吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **3 秒内点 2 次以上** | 卡片弹一下。纯本地。 | 不花 |
| **单次点击** | 让模型说一句短话，只显示在卡片上 —— **不进对话** | 花 |
| **模型调用失败** | 退回预置句。**按钮永远有回音。** | 不花 |

调用用的是你已有的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，从 DSH 的凭据服务读。不用新 key，不用新账号。

---

dsh-fish-card README · 设置：点卡片上的 **⚙**。

| 设置项 | 选项 |
| --- | --- |
| **模式** | **天天看** —— 每 2 分钟轮询，一直可见 · **偶尔瞥** —— 每 30 分钟轮询，淡到 45%，鼠标移上去恢复 |
| **轮询间隔** | 覆盖模式默认值，单位分钟 |
| **显示叫醒按钮** | 想安静就关掉 |
| **回到左下角** | 位置重置 |

设置存在 `localStorage` 里，键前缀 `dfc-`。

dsh-fish-card README · 拖动与缩放：- **拖动** —— 按住顶部状态栏。卡片会记住你放的位置
- **缩放** —— 用右下角的把手
- **不做边缘吸附** —— 你放哪儿就是哪儿

dsh-fish-card README · 和 `dsh-whale-widget` 共存：如果你同时装了 [`dsh-whale-widget`](https://github.com/MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget)，两者不冲突。

| 面 | whale-widget | fish-card |

| 路由 | `/dsh-whale/*` | `/dsh-fish/*` |
| CSS 类 | `.dshwv-*` | `.dfc-*` |
| localStorage | `dshw-*` | `dfc-*` |
| 全局变量 | `window.__dshWhale*`、`window.__dshw*` | `window.__dshFishCard` |
| z-index | 最高 `2147483600` | `2147482000` —— **在它下面** |
| MutationObserver | 常驻 2 个 | 1 个，**挂载后立刻断开** |

dsh-fish-card README · 和 `dsh-whale-widget` 共存：唯一的跨插件接触是**一行只读的 `querySelector('.dshwv-root')`** —— 用来在你把卡片拖到鲸鱼身上时让卡片自己躲开。

**只读那个矩形。从不写对方任何东西。**

> 把卡片拖到鲸鱼身上，卡片躲开。鲸鱼不动。

dsh-fish-card README · 工作原理：```
宿主 —— lib/index.js
  ├─ GET  /dsh-fish/card.json    →  { status, line, hasAvatar, hasTail, ts }
  ├─ GET  /dsh-fish/card.js      →  前端脚本
  ├─ GET  /dsh-fish/avatar.png   →  立绘  （文件不在就 404）

**注入**只用一条结构化注入行，`kind: 'script-src'`，走 `webserver/index-inject`。这是桌面壳唯一认的通道 —— `tapIndex` 在那边永远不跑，因为壳直接从 `app.asar` 里读静态 `index.html`。

dsh-fish-card README · 工作原理：> ### ⚠️ 唯一值得记住的坑
>
> 宿主只认 **六种**注入行 kind：
>
> `global` · `script` · `script-src` · `script-preload` · `style` · `html`
>
> **用别的 kind，宿主在渲染 index 时会抛错**，表现出来是启动时报
> `Web authentication failed` —— 一个跟真实原因毫无关系的错误信息。
>
> 本项目在这个错误上白丢了两小时。别自己发明新的 kind。
